response.query: What pilot protocol (sample, duration, key metrics, fraud and reconciliation tests) is needed to validate voucher flow, merchant reimbursement, digital systems, and market response?
response.answer: Pilot protocol includes a 3-month sample period, key metrics like transaction volume and fraud rates, and reconciliation tests for voucher flow and merchant reimbursement. Fraud detection and reconciliation processes are essential.

results.title: Cross Border Payment Processing
results.content: *   [Cross-border eCommerce Get all the payment partners you need in a single integration](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/international-payments-expansion). Cross-border transactions can be initiated through various channels, including credit or debit cards, wire transfers, digital transfers, bank transfers, or [alternative payment methods](https://www.aciworldwide.com/alternative-payment-methods). *   The impending global adoption of [ISO 20022](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/iso-20022) will create international cross-border message standards and enhance cross-border payments efficiency. *   **Regional regulations**, such as the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation’s [Cross-Border Privacy Rules (CBPR)](https://www.apec.org/about-us/about-apec/fact-sheets/what-is-the-cross-border-privacy-rules-system), which facilitate international data transfers and privacy protection among participating economies, and [Europe’s Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2)](https://www.aciworldwide.com/sca-psd2) — [soon to be PSD3](https://www.aciworldwide.com/psd3) — which aims to enhance security, innovation, and competition in the payments industry while promoting consumer rights. Our capabilities enable banks to process and [manage international payments](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/cross-border-payments) across multiple networks and geographies, while helping merchants align transactions with relevant [local payment methods](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/international-payments-expansion), [acquiring models](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/multi-acquiring), [fraud controls](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/aci-fraud-management-merchants), and authentication requirements. [**Contact us today**](https://www.aciworldwide.com/about-aci/contact-us) to learn how ACI Worldwide supports secure, scalable cross-border payment processing for banks and merchants worldwide. *   [Cross-border eCommerce](https://www.aciworldwide.com/solutions/international-payments-expansion).
